title: AtmosCoder-Bench: Execution-grounded evaluation of large language models on atmospheric-science computation
description: Benchmark and evaluation harness accompanying the manuscript "Execution-grounded evaluation reveals hidden failures in language-model calculations for environmental science" (under review). Each problem provides only the problem statement (textbook-supplied formulas are stripped); the model writes a Python solve() function, the harness executes it in an isolated sandbox, and the numerical output is graded against certified ground truth at 5% relative tolerance with unit reconciliation. The archive contains the 436 core problems (4,346 graded instances), the execution/grading pipeline, the analysis code behind every reported statistic, and the documentation. Raw per-run model outputs (~5 GB) are deposited separately; see the README. Model API credentials are not included (see models.example.toml).
